reviews.text: Came to get my dogs vaccines great staff Mia and Stephanie in the front desk were very nice
Says affordable animal hospital. I was quoted $600 for a spay for my cat…..

My dog was diagnosed with cancer and was dying. We had her on medication that was making her feel okay but it wasn't going to last. We came to this vet just to refill her medication, we didn't need any further advice or opinions since we knew our time was limited. Upon arrival the first impression was not good, it smells like a liter box and it was dirty. The staff was nice but the doctor was rude and unhelpful. The prices are not cheaper than anywhere else. I ended up taking my dog to her original vet that was a hour away. There are better places for better prices out there.

My baby passed away in my arms at a vet that we trusted, in a facility that was clean and with staff that truly cared for my little one.

Trust me, your pet deserves better.

Prices aren’t that affordable. Ended up going to LA Veterinary Center, saved money and they were more thorough with my dogs physical, the discovered some stuff missed at this hospital. The staff here was really nice I was just fooled by the name into thinking id save money with them.
Base dental cleaning was around 850 plus 300 per tooth removal.
At the other place it’s 500 base price plus 17-75 bucks per tooth removal. Insane how big of a difference this is.

I brought in my puppy Fendi for a routine exam and shots and nail trim and there was a wonderful experience. Wonderful customer service. I would highly recommend them.

Thank you to the team!
They help me in matter of time to check my dog. Staff was patient nice and provide many alternative treatments for my sick dog.

Finding out my dog needed surgery to remove tumors was really stressful since she’s almost 12 years old but this clinic made the whole experience so much easier. Thank you so much to the entire team for the successful surgery. They removed three tumors, and everything went smoothly.

Everyone was amazing from the doctor to the veterinary technicians and the front desk staff. Every person i met was kind, friendly, patient, and genuinely cared about my dog. They answered all of my questions and made us feel comfortable every step of the way.

On top of the outstanding care, their prices were much more reasonable than many other clinics that charge outrageous amounts for the same procedures. It’s such a relief to find a place that provides excellent care without taking advantage of pet owners.

I am incredibly grateful and would absolutely recommend this clinic to anyone looking for compassionate, honest, and skilled veterinary care.
Victoria and all the staff are awesome..very kind and friendly...met 2 of the drs...and they're awesome...treated my lil doggy tinkerbell like a queen

Brought my dog in for an urgent visit on a Sunday morning. The staff was friendly and accommodating. Dr Barrera was very kind and explained what was wrong with my dog. He even explained the test results from our previous vet, so we could understand what was going on. She has pancreatitis and was in rough shape. We have her on a treatment plan and I'm hopeful she'll recover soon. After my experience at Affordable Animal Hospital, I will not be going back to our previous vet.

If it were possible, I would give this place a -0.00000000001 rating.

Let me start from the beginning. On February 15, 2026, at around 7:30 AM, I brought my cat Coco here because he had been unable to urinate since about 2:30 PM on February 14. I had no other option and came here hoping for emergency help.
We were the first customers when they opened at 8:00 AM. At first, I honestly thought it was a beauty salon because there were so many people at the front desk. I explained Coco’s condition to a staff member, and she told me it would be $500 just for the emergency exam. I asked if someone could see him right away since there were no other patients, but my concern was ignored.
Around 9:28 AM, an older male staff member took my cat away. Coco had already been unable to urinate for about 19 hours, yet nobody seemed concerned about the urgency of his condition.
They first presented me with a bill of about $3,500, including a two-night stay. When I said I could not afford that, they brought a revised estimate of about $3200, mainly for placing a catheter to relieve the blockage. I agreed because I had no choice.The clinic told us to come back in five hours. Later, when I reviewed Coco’s treatment records, I discovered that treatment did not actually begin until 3:00 PM on February 15. That means Coco went about 25 hours without urinating, a condition that can be life-threatening.If you love your pet, I would not recommend this clinic. For comparison, Profouna Clinic in Tijuana charges far less. Their PU surgery costs about $540, while similar procedures in Los Angeles can cost around $10,000. Overnight care there is about $134 per night.Everything I described regarding Affordable Animal Clinic Silver Lake is supported by documentation and records that I have kept.
